name: Oxomemazine
summary: Oxomemazine is an antihistamine and anticholinergic of the phenothiazine chemical class for the treatment of cough.

pharmacology.text: Oxomemazine is an antihistamine and anticholinergic of the phenothiazine chemical class for the treatment of cough.

uses.text: Oxomemazine is an antihistamine and anticholinergic of the phenothiazine chemical class for the treatment of cough.

summaryZh: 奧索馬嗪（英語：Oxomemazine），又稱二氧異丁嗪、雙氧異丁嗪，是吩噻嗪化學類的抗組胺藥和抗膽鹼能藥，可用於治療咳嗽。根據2019年法國醫學雜誌《處方》的第7次報告，基於科學數據和可替代選擇，以奧索馬嗪為基礎的藥物Toplexil被列為93種應避免使用的藥物之一（其中82種當時在法國銷售）。

sideEffects.en: It causes marked drowsiness, dry mouth, blurred vision and constipation. Phenothiazines can disturb the heart's rhythm, and too much can cause confusion and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成明顯嗜睡、口乾、視力模糊與便祕。吩噻嗪類可能擾亂心臟節律，用量過多時可能造成意識混亂與癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成明显嗜睡、口干、视力模糊与便秘。吩噻嗪类可能扰乱心脏节律，用量过多时可能造成意识混乱与癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is a phenothiazine, from the same chemical family as chlorpromazine, but it is used for coughs and allergy rather than for psychosis.
fact.zh: 它屬於吩噻嗪類，與氯普麻同一化學家族，但用途是止咳與抗過敏，而非治療精神病。
fact.zhHans: 它属于吩噻嗪类，与氯普麻同一化学家族，但用途是止咳与抗过敏，而非治疗精神病。
